subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Manas said that Sooraj had arrived on Friday.

options.text: Manas says, “Sooraj is arrived on Friday.”
Manas says, “Sooraj has be arrives on Friday.”

solution:
The correct answer is** option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech.**
 
• The process of changing an indirect speech to direct speech involves:
 
 
• Identifying the speaker of the reporting speech, which is **“Manas”**.
 
• Noting the reporting verb** 'said'**. In direct speech, it stays** 'said'**.
 
• The phrase **“Sooraj had arrived on Friday”** will change into **simple past** when transformed into direct speech because it reflects an event that has already occurred, and its timeframe does not need to be modified.
 
• The presence of **‘had’** is omitted in the conversion as it suggests a completed action that fits directly into **simple past tense** for direct speech.
 
 

**Therefore, the direct speech conversion is: *Manas said, “Sooraj arrived on Friday.”***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s identify the reporting speech and reported speech.

 
 
• He said, “I go to school every day.”
 
• In the above sentence “He said” is the reporting speech.
 
• “I go to school every day.” is the reported speech.
